changes.title: Offline multilingual search for UIMSD tables and statistics
changes.text: Search all public UIMSD table/view titles, categories, descriptions and field names from Home or any table. Ranked results open normal UIMSD views; Unicode and common multilingual terms are supported locally, without an AI service or private-data indexing.

changes.title: Protect privacy and test multilingual search
changes.text: Full core run39261967725 passed 1890 methods with zero failure/error/skip; new search regressions cover relevance, Unicode, Spanish/Russian/Chinese/Korean/Japanese terms, AND filtering, private metadata safety, limit, all without internet. New real Android picker touch method queued for API34.

changes.title: Deliver matched developer and player APKs every build
changes.text: Establish automatic two-APK parity for this and later private Codex builds, including TEST285's separately delivered normal player preview; preserve embedded histories, same debug signing, app identity and prior APKs without publishing.
